patterns.evidence: artwork_id holds only the ObjectId of an artworks document; no artwork attribute such as its name or artist is copied into the project.
conservator_id holds only the ObjectId of the lead conservator in the conservators collection, with no copied fields like full_name or email.

condition_issues is an array of sub-documents (location, issue_type, severity, treatment, optional notes) describing the damage found on the artwork for this project; these issues exist only inside the project and no collection stores them separately.
materials is a short list of plain strings describing what the work is made of, for example "poplar panel"; it is a multi-valued attribute, not identifiers or sub-documents.
specialties is a bounded list of plain strings naming the conservator's areas of expertise, for example "varnish removal"; a simple multi-valued attribute.
